wikiclonecomment-desc: Clone articles from an upstream wiki and annotate them with clearly-marked local commentary anchored to headings
wikiclonecomment-attribution: The body of this page is copied from the article $1 on $5 (revision $3, synced $6). That text is available under $4 — see the $2. Passages marked as commentary are written by contributors to this wiki and are not part of the original article.
wikiclonecomment-not-synced: This page is set to clone $1, but nothing has been downloaded yet. The next sync run will fill it in.
wikiclonecomment-source-conflict: The stored copy of $1 came from $2, but this page asks for $3. Nothing is shown, because serving content from the wrong source would misattribute it.
wikiclonecomment-orphaned-intro: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|comment|comments}} below {{PLURAL:$1|was|were}} anchored to a heading that no longer exists in the source article. The source text changed — move {{PLURAL:$1|it|them}} to a heading that is still there.
wikiclonecomment-error-no-target: Clone directive: no article given. Use {{#wikiclone: Page title}} or paste the full URL of the upstream article.
wikiclonecomment-error-no-sources: Clone directive: this wiki has no upstream sources configured. Set $wgWikiCloneSources.
wikiclonecomment-error-source-not-allowe: Clone directive: $1 is not an allowed source. This wiki may clone from: $2
wikiclonecomment-error-bad-url: Clone directive: $1 is not a recognisable article URL. Expected something like https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Page_title.
wikiclonecomment-error-ambiguous-source: Clone directive: several sources are configured and none is the default, so a bare page title is ambiguous. Paste the full URL of the article instead.
wikiclonecomment-error-duplicate: Clone directive: a page can only clone one article. Remove the extra directive.
wikiclonecomment-error-encode: The fetched article could not be encoded as JSON.
wikiclonecomment-error-foreign-content: A page that clones an article may contain only the clone directive and <wikiclone-comment> blocks — everything else would render outside the marked commentary and blur the line between your words and the source's. Remove this text: $1 If the page had content before, it is still in the page history: open the previous revision, copy what is worth keeping, and paste it inside a <wikiclone-comment> block.
wikiclonecomment-tracking-category-desc: The page uses {{#wikiclone:}}, so its body is copied from an upstream wiki.
wikiclonecomment-orphaned-category: Pages with comments on a missing heading
wikiclonecomment-orphaned-category-desc: A comment on the page is anchored to a heading that no longer exists in the source article.
wikiclonecomment-error-category: Pages with a broken clone directive
wikiclonecomment-error-category-desc: The clone directive on the page could not be resolved, or nothing has been synced for it.
